scope: 48 independent review findings plus original remaining mitigations, integrated verification, merge and fresh comprehensive review

findings.title: Seven implemented workflows redirect or link to missing canonical pages
findings.notes: Independent review found the prior registry checked legacy modules. Seven canonical /admin wrappers now reuse those implementations; actual imports, redirect resolution and production manifest checks replace the shallow assertions. Correction remains pending fresh independent review; no authenticated navigation acceptance is claimed.

findings.title: Executive overview converts retrieval failures into an all-clear message
findings.notes: Required executive reads use the strict client loader and surface Retry on failure; optional presence fallback and partial occupancy/KPI labels remain explicit. Focused regression: 30 passed, 0 failed across five files. No authenticated staff UAT claimed.

findings.title: Resident search entries keep their former facility authorization scope
Saved report variants cannot be run from their own Run Report link
Full reporting exports are built from truncated preview data
Executive subsection navigation excludes keyboard and hides its mobile fallback
findings.notes: A single most-specific permitted destination is current; Overview matches exactly. Rendered tests open the mobile drawer on Alerts and Standup history and mount the real navigation through both Overview and Alerts pages. Role filtering and keyboard focus remain supported. Correction remains pending fresh independent review.

findings.title: The med-tech cockpit is offered to administrators whom the proxy immediately sends home
Standup draft creation can reserve the whole week with missing or partial metrics
Unified Search promises record types the repository never indexes
Executive date-range preferences save but never affect any KPI view
The overtime report counts unapproved punches while labeling the result approved
The med-tech shift and pass queue has no operational producer
The kitchen command deck has no daily service/ticket creation workflow
A family bulletin draft can follow the operator to a different resident
Staff bulletin history hides new messages once a resident exceeds 200 notes
Email/SMS/call delivery selections only save a label
Entering a historical assessment can overwrite the resident's current fall risk
Official discharge leaves the old bed occupied
The discharge workspace has no durable notice/recipient checklist
Controlled-substance count cards omit the resident and dose identity
findings.notes: Both entry points use shared usable legal-name validation. Saved count identities are resolved by persisted medication references within facility scope, including inactive medications. Unresolved identity blocks co-signing with retry recovery. Correction remains pending fresh independent Astra clinical review; no live clinical action or hosted acceptance is claimed.

findings.title: An interrupted compliance scan becomes the latest scored scan
Saving one referral section erases unsaved work in the others
A complete reconciliation can retain its complete label after required evidence is erased
Medication queue urgency freezes while the cockpit remains open
account disabling leaves database authority active
findings.notes: Isolated role/lifecycle/retry matrix and targeted hosted owner/current/revoked-session probes passed. Named-user operational UAT remains separate.

findings.title: quality view bypasses tenant and role RLS
observation completion is not atomic or replay-safe
direct observation writes bypass protected completion fields
signing integration authorizes organization but not facility
findings.notes: Original same-organization cross-facility bypass is verified corrected: entry, pre-send and pre-link guards deny without returning signing data, and an authorized multi-site nurse remains supported. A focused actual-handler characterization reproduces a remaining in-flight final-link disclosure after facility revocation; assign that P1 gap to Section 4 with Astra High. No live provider or authenticated UAT claimed.

findings.title: signing retries and webhook duplicates can corrupt local contract state
audit export marks a truncated page as a completed export
facility revocation handler has no routable facility parameter
findings.notes: Isolated role/lifecycle/retry matrix and targeted hosted owner/current/revoked-session probes passed. Named-user operational UAT remains separate.

findings.title: publication receipts are neither immutable nor constrained to the submit transition
Payment success does not confirm invoice application
A failed PO line save leaves an orphan header and duplicates on retry
Retry treats an unposted journal draft as already posted
Insurance review and publication stamps can describe different text
Certification staff-load failures are presented as an empty selector
findings.notes: Retry recovery retains all credential fields and repeats facility, active-employment and soft-delete filters. A follow-up independent review identified stale facility responses; generation/facility guards now reject obsolete success/error/finally results, invalidate old staff selection, and require current-roster eligibility before save. Deferred-response regressions cover both reported races, pending loading, A-B-A and an in-flight organization lookup. Remains implemented_review_pending for fresh independent review; no authenticated RLS acceptance claimed.

findings.title: Payroll exports can retain superseded approved punch values
Local remediation and hosted migration history are not a deployable matched baseline
findings.notes: Local HEAD, origin/main, GitHub main and published Netlify production matched at Phase 0 baseline 624e7712. Hosted migrations contain every local version; 319-329 match exact names/content, 317-318 match names and statements except local outer transaction wrappers/blank lines, and six hosted-only historical timestamps remain preserved. Auth, PostgREST and Edge release metadata match the paired release. Metadata does not claim hosted bundle equality, provider acceptance or named-user UAT.

findings.title: Activity confirmation has no operational session creation or attendance journey
The latest quality-result view returns conflicting rows for a corrected period
Public inquiry and tour forms confirm work that was never sent or saved
HL7 lead conversion can persist a lead while leaving its inbox item unlinked
Knowledge review completion can succeed without the review event
Manual escalation advances the task without delivering its configured SMS or voice notification
Maintenance work orders persist but lack assignment, worker handoff and a complete backlog
Completing asset service does not update the asset’s service lifecycle

stop_boundary: Phase 0 only: verify NAV-002, SYS-005 and DEP-001, deliver their evidence, then stop. Sections 1 through 8 are not started.
